correctness.rationale: The exact Laplacian is L(P_n)+w(e0-e_{n-1})(e0-e_{n-1})^T and commutes with end reflection. Even-parity path cosine eigenmodes q_{2r} survive; their coordinate at vertex1 is cos(3 pi r/n), zero exactly for 6|n. The odd-parity restriction is irreducible Jacobi, with first diagonal 1+2w; its simple eigenvalues strictly increase with w and strictly interlace neighboring path levels. Thus cross-parity eigenvalue coincidence occurs only at w=1, the uniform cycle, whose repeated eigenvalues defeat one scalar sensor. For w !=1, an odd blind eigenmode has v1=0 and necessarily lambda=1+2w and v0=-v2; its remaining sine-tail subject to reflection right boundary gives theta=2pi k/(n-3), with 0<theta<pi and positive w=1/2-cos theta. Conversely each listed positive resonance constructs a blind nonzero odd eigenvector. n=5 has empty index range; all positive weights covered. PBH symmetry gives controllability. Independent eigensystem tests 142 n/weight cases had 0 discrepancies. Finite testing is not the infinite proof.
